title: How to Write a Cover Letter with AI in Seconds (with Teal)
description:
Teal's AI cover letter generator writes a tailored cover letter in seconds, built from your resume and the exact job you're applying to — no blank page, no copy-pasting.

Match to a job, shape the tone and length, and let the AI draft a cover letter that actually fits the role. Edit it, export it, and reuse your resume content for every application.
